method.null_calibration: paired leave-one-out component p-values transformed by the identical statistic
method.final_pvalue: empirical upper-tail survival against the transformed paired null statistics

primary_endpoint: weak AUROC on k=4,6,8 positive episodes versus all held-out negatives
secondary_endpoints: worst reporting-sector false-positive rate at alpha 0.05
recall at alpha 0.05 and 0.01 for k=4,6,8,12

decision_rule.retain_optional: execution passes and at least one of weak AUROC or balanced alpha-0.05 recall exceeds wavelet, but promotion fails
decision_rule.reject: execution passes and neither weak AUROC nor balanced alpha-0.05 recall exceeds wavelet

claim_boundary: Promotion would establish a prospectively validated sparse-episode detector on SonotaCo benchmarks. It would not by itself establish blind catalogue discovery of OrbitTrace, formal shower status, or historical first discovery.
